body: You will see this spot in every review of Sri Lanka and listed as a place to visit. Reality is not as you see in numerous posts. First getting there surprisingly difficult. Eventually we saw a path off the main road and a few steps along saw a sign.The walk was about 10 mins or so and climbing up and in the heat that was a challenge. We eventually to to the spot and two things stuck out. First there was no charge to got to the hill and second there were lots of people. You can get similar views all along the south coast driving up from Mirissa with lots of photo opportunities.

body: Coconut Hill in Mirissa is a breathtakingly scenic spot that perfectly captures Sri Lanka’s tropical beauty. Perched on a small hill overlooking the Indian Ocean, it’s lined with tall, swaying coconut trees, making it a dream location for photographers and nature lovers.The best time to visit is early morning or sunset when the golden light enhances the picturesque views. The ocean breeze and the sound of waves crashing below create a peaceful atmosphere. However, it can get quite crowded, especially during peak tourist seasons.While the short hike up is easy, be cautious of loose soil on the slope. There are no facilities nearby, so bringing water and sun protection is a good idea. Overall, Coconut Hill is a must-visit if you're in Mirissa, offering one of the most iconic coastal views in Sri Lanka.
title: Coconut tree Hill Mirissa

body: As a tour guide, Coconut Tree Hills in Mirissa is one of my favorite spots to introduce visitors to Sri Lanka’s coastal beauty. The gentle incline offers a leisurely stroll with panoramic vistas that are perfect for relaxation and photography. It’s an excellent spot for guests seeking a serene retreat or a memorable backdrop for their travel photos. The charm of Coconut Tree Hills lies in its natural simplicity and the unspoiled beauty that captures the essence of Sri Lanka’s coastal allure.

body: Our second dy has started with the visit to Coconut tree hill, Mirissa.When you continue to Matara side there will be a narrow path on right side with a board on the wall "coconut tree hill". Take that road and you will find where to start climbing on your left side. There will be a foot path. follow the foot path up to hill. That property is owned by a temple and you will require a ticket 100/=locals, 150/= foreigners to enter the coconut tree hill. Prefer you to visit here around 9-10in the morning as in the afternoons and evenings will be corwded by the locals. You can have a fine, calm moment here watching the sea and sky through the coconut leaves. Anyone can reach this place easily. but with kids be careful as it is an open land which is surrounded by the sea. But there is enough space for you to enjoy.
title: Scenic view point...

body: This is a spectacular view point for watching sunrise, sunset or just taking in the views of the unique landscape. Out on a peninsula , tons of palm trees have grown out of the distinct red soil. It has become quite popular spot on Instagram but still worth a visit. We reached it by walking up the hill just to the left of Sunset Bar.
title: Great place for taking photos

body: It is one place you must not miss if you are in this little touristy town - Mirissa.I just had a picture of this place with no specific location tag and I spent quite sometime heavily using my google search skills to finally locate it. It is named as - Coconut Tree Hill. The best part about Mirissa town is that every good place worth visiting is just 10-15mins walk away. Coconut Hill Tree was an easy peasy 10mins walk from the main road.The hill top is located at the end of the beach. It is crazy windy and you’ll be surrounded by sky high coconut trees forming a dome. You can hear the soothing sound of the waves hitting the shore all the time and gaze at the beautiful sight of the trees perched over Indian ocean for as long as you like. Go there with the best camera you have and an empty SD card.

body: This viewpoint is stunning! You can see Mirissa’s beach from here its well worth a visit if you’re in Mirissa.

title: excellent place
body: amazing view point and very beautiful place/. best place to see the sunset if you bring your camera. stunning pictures you can take. you wish to visit this place, i recommend you to walk through the beach. it is amazing.

title: Unique view over ocean through coconut trees
body: This place has an unique view over the ocean through a small hill with coconut trees. Best to visit at dawn or dusk. Currently there were notices by police saying for security purposes it is only open for public between 1 to 6 pm. So avoid other times to stay away from any trouble. There’s a small distance from galle road. Best to park the vehicle by galle road and walk the distance as the road leading to this place is narrow and there’s no proper place to park the vehicle there.

title: Coconut Tree Hill was the best view point to get beautiful view of the sunset and the beach from under the coconut tress
body: Coconut Tree Hill was a local attraction in Mirissa, which was suggested to me by my hosts. It was within a kilometer from Mirrisa Beach and you have to turn right from the main road and head over to a link road which later turns into a narrow dusty path. On reaching the top, you find another link path, a much narrow one to the main view point. It was really a beautiful sight. You can enjoy the sunset from there and even the view of the ocean. If you are staying around Mirissa and love to explore new places like me, then this would be a great sight for you ofcourse. There are not much people at this place and no restaurents at the viewpoint. Carry an umbrella if you prefer to walk and be careful while standing under the coconuts tree. Coconuts often fall from the tree without warning and wear nice shoes so you dont slip as the place is slippery due to sandy stones.
